parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. Obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time format is yyyyMMdd, such as 20190401.

parameters.name: RobotInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the chatbot instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time format is yyyyMMdd, such as 20190401.
